criteria.reason: Phased numbered steps with actions and deadlines; clearly ordered and actionable.
Vehicle 14-day rule present, but 14-day municipal registration deadline omitted; Zurich deregistration also missing.
Flags cantonal differences and directs user to offices and official checklists for verification.
Understandable but excessively long; includes tangential packing and contact-list advice beyond scope.

summary: Detailed ordered moving checklist flagging cantonal variation, but omits the key 14-day municipal registration deadline and is overly verbose.
